scope: Only the strict ConditionResolutionScope disposal correction and its focused regression assertions. No edits to runtime or tests; no runtime execution; no general condition, owner-publication, purity, or module acceptance.

resolvedFinding.description: Previously, out-of-order disposal could disable an inner strict guard, and repeated disposal of a retired inner strict scope could reinstall its retired parent.
resolvedFinding.correction: A retired strict scope returns before any ambient-state change. When either the disposed frame or active frame is strict, a non-current frame throws before setting readDisposed, replacing current, or clearing entries. A valid strict disposal marks the frame retired and restores its previous frame exactly once.
resolvedFinding.legacyBoundary: For legacy-only scopes, both strict predicates remain false and the original current = previous; entries?.Clear() behavior is retained. Disposing a legacy frame under an active strict frame is deliberately rejected to preserve the new read guard.

regressionReview.assertion: Entering nested strict frames and disposing the outer first throws; an immediate Restore still throws, demonstrating that the active read guard was not removed.
Disposing the inner normally retains the outer lifecycle guard; disposing the outer then unwinds normally.
Disposing the retired inner again does not reinstall its retired parent, so legacy Restore succeeds; final cleanup repeats both disposals safely.

validationClaim: Static review only. Parent-reported compilation and execution were not independently executed or adopted as runtime evidence in this record.
acceptanceBoundary: The bounded disposal defect is resolved. No assertion that other proposed semantic tests, the complete condition read path, all profiles, or INT-05 qualification are complete.
